free_tier_limits: 500 requests per month on the free Basic plan, enforced as a hard limit
rate_limits: Free plan: 500 requests/month hard limit; HTTP 429 after quota exhaustion. Paid plans raise monthly quota only. Endpoint-specific date-range caps also apply (e.g. daily max 10 years per request). No separate per-second limit published.
description: Meteostat's JSON API serves historical hourly, daily, and monthly weather observations plus climate normals from thousands of stations and model-backed point queries. Hosted on RapidAPI, it returns JSON with meta and data objects for station lookup, nearby search, and time-series ranges. Free for light use with 500 calls/month; paid RapidAPI plans raise the quota. Separate free bulk dumps and a Python library exist outside this API.
